svg.title: Hand width
svg.desc: Two top views of the one-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with hand size set to Measure my hand, a 25 mm wide plug in teal. Right: hand width at 100 mm. The red line marks the body at its widest and reads 100 mm, the number you type; the body is drawn 80.3 mm wide, narrower than the hand, as its width is worked out from the hand width. Marked in red: 1, the wing openings and the body edge: the two openings beside the pocket; the outer outline.
